text: JKN collaborates with private healthcare providers to enhance service delivery and accessibility. A significant milestone in its journey was the approval of a US$400 million loan by the World Bank in 2021, aimed at improving the quality and efficiency of JKN. This effort was further supported by a grant of US$2.33 million from the Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation, administered through the World Bank’s Indonesia Human Capital Acceleration multi-donor trust fund. This funding is directed towards strengthening JKN's capacity for implementation and coordination. From 2014 to 2019, JKN expanded its coverage dramatically, encompassing 83% of the population and significantly reducing individual out-of-pocket healthcare expenditures.
